(1) the use of numeric methods to support descriptive scenario analysis can be useful for highlighting the importance of dependability requirements; (2) the use of a combination of numeric methods and descriptive methods is useful for highlighting the impact of dependability issues in the design of a human-machine interface; and (3) the use of the proposed approach is useful for improving human reliability design
